title: evolve gc reaps host tmux sessions and sockets before refusing a missing --project-root, so a unit test runs real host reapers
summary: Found by comment-reduction cmd/evolve group 3 (2026-09-26); verified by the console. cmd/evolve/cmd_gc.go runs swarm.ExecReapOrphans and ExecReapOrphanSockets, which are real host reaps, before the mutating-run check that refuses without --project-root. A bare `evolve gc` therefore reaps, then exits 1. TestRunGC_MutatingRunRefusesWithoutProjectRoot (cmd_gc_workspace_test.go) goes through that path, so `go test ./cmd/evolve` runs the real reapers against the host tmux server during the test. They only reap dead-owner sessions, but a test must not act on the host. The help text also says the root defaults to the current directory, while a mutating run refuses without it.
fix: Validate arguments, including the --project-root refusal, before any reap. Inject the reapers through the command's seams so tests never touch the host tmux server, and correct the help text.
acceptance: a bare `evolve gc` refuses without reaping anything (test with fake reapers)
no cmd/evolve test calls swarm.Exec* reapers (AST or seam pin)
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: The test acts on the live host from inside lanes, though it reaps only dead-owner sessions so the risk is low, and the help text contradicts the refusal.
